purpose: Read-only prioritised projection of Defence Command Centre rows into human attention, blocked, safe machine action available, and healthy/no-action buckets.

buckets.meaning: The existing next action explicitly requires human judgement, or a pre-candidate human diff review is in progress/not started.
The current state has no authorised automatic path and requires repair, profile-claim refresh or investigation before workflow can continue.
An existing guarded helper is available and the next action does not require human judgement. The queue never executes it.
No current Defence action is required.

rules: Classification uses Command Centre fields only and never recomputes certification, deployment or review validity.
Explicit nextAction.humanRequired always maps to human_attention.
Pre-candidate review progress not_started or in_progress maps to human_attention.
blocked_canonical_state, profile_refresh_required, needs_review without an authorised helper, partial-service observation gaps and other no-helper remediation states map to blocked.
A non-human next action with an existing helper maps to machine_action_available.
nextAction none maps to healthy_no_action unless another explicit blocked/human condition applies.
Ordering is deterministic: human_attention, blocked, machine_action_available, healthy_no_action; then workflow-stage priority; then app id.
Priority is workflow ordering only, not a security risk score.
The attention queue is read-only and never invokes a helper.
nonClaims: Earlier queue position does not mean an app is less safe.
machine_action_available does not mean the action has been executed.
healthy_no_action does not imply perfect security.
